$comment: Page-weight budgets for the documentation site, checked in CI by scripts/verify-page-weight.php. Calibrated on 2026-10-20 (main 57686108: icon catalogue, WebP home page): 133 pages, median 2.67 MB, home 2.86 MB, heaviest ordinary page 4.02 MB (ru/examples/extensions/), largest image 1.16 MB (assets/docara-flow.png, since replaced: on 2026-10-26 the example images became generated WebP files of at most 104 KB). Static estimate; headless Chrome loads 0.5-0.9 MB more per page (Framework chunks a script loads, icon weights picked at run time).

/ru/examples/extensions/.reason: 5.08 MB: the heaviest ordinary page, an example gallery; the Framework search, contents, pager and settings components (sf-search, sf-contents, sf-pager, sf-context-menu) every page loads since 3.10.0 took it past the default.

/ru/components/icon/.reason: 5.21 MB: the icon page draws every family, weight and fill, so it loads catalogue faces the other pages do not, and lists all 3926 icon names.

/ru/components/diagram/.reason: 7.00 MB: Mermaid (3.57 MB) renders the diagrams on this page.

/ru/components/diagram-gallery/.reason: 7.37 MB: Mermaid (3.57 MB) loads once for the 22 diagrams; the page's own HTML is 264 KB (30 KB gzipped), every diagram's source twice, live and on its Markdown tab.
